# AlwaysReadyHQ

> AlwaysReadyHQ empowers community helpers with thoughtful, competence-based emergency preparedness and disaster response strategies.

AlwaysReadyHQ is a resource hub dedicated to practical preparedness and community readiness. Founded with a focus on empowering community emergency responders and helpers, the site emphasizes competence-based approaches to disaster preparedness and response.

## Key Topics

- Emergency Preparedness
- Community Readiness
- Disaster Response
- CERT (Community Emergency Response Team)
- Competence-Based Preparedness
- Prepping Philosophy
- Community Helpers
- Acts of God
- Anita Brown
- Atlanta
- Georgia

## About & Mission

- [About - AlwaysReadyHQ](https://www.alwaysreadyhq.com/about): AlwaysReadyHQ's mission: thoughtful preparation & readiness for community helpers.
